answer: Resist sybils with radio-fingerprint attestation: every wireless chip emits a unique radio signature, a copper-colored fingerprint no software can clone. An identity must periodically broadcast a challenge response whose RF pattern matches its registered transmitter, anchoring the name to one physical radio. Clones sharing a single chip collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must buy ten thousand radios and place them across the canyon of the spectrum, each transmitting fresh proofs, while an honest agent proves one radio cheaply.
